Reconcile Two Risk Registers

Source: R/reconcile_risk_registers.R
reconcile_risk_registers.Rd

Aligns two versions of a risk register by their risk identifier and reports, item by item, exactly what changed between them: which risks were added, removed, left unchanged, or changed, and for the changed risks, which fields differ. Where risk_trend() tracks the whole trajectory over many milestones and risk_reduction_summary() quantifies how much RPN was removed, reconcile_risk_registers() gives the line-by-line audit of a single pair, as a reviewer comparing a prior submission draft against the current one, or two assessors' independent registers, would want to see.

Usage

reconcile_risk_registers(
  prior,
  current,
  fields = c("description", "category", "probability", "impact", "detectability", "owner",
    "mitigation", "status"),
  config = risk_config_default()
)

Arguments

prior

A risk_register from create_risk_register(): the earlier or baseline version.

current

A risk_register from create_risk_register(): the later or comparison version.

fields

Character vector of column names whose differences define a "changed" risk. Defaults to the assessment and management fields c("description", "category", "probability", "impact", "detectability", "owner", "mitigation", "status"). Every name must be a column of both registers.

config

A risk_config from risk_config_default(). Accepted for interface consistency with the other register functions; the stored RPN and levels are used as-is, so it currently influences nothing.

Value

A list of class "risk_reconciliation" with:

  • per_risk: a tibble with one row per risk in the union of the two registers and columns risk_id, change_type, n_fields_changed, changed_fields (comma-separated, NA when none), rpn_prior, rpn_current, rpn_delta, level_prior, and level_current;

  • field_changes: a long tibble of every differing field on the changed risks, with columns risk_id, field, value_prior, and value_current (values rendered as character for a uniform audit column);

  • scalar counts n_prior, n_current, n_added, n_removed, n_changed, n_unchanged;

  • total_rpn_prior, total_rpn_current, total_rpn_delta, the register-level RPN movement over the stored values;

  • fields, the tracked field names used.

Details

The two registers are matched on risk_id (unique within a register, since create_risk_register() rejects duplicates). Each risk in the union of the two is assigned one change_type:

  • "added" — present in current but not in prior;

  • "removed" — present in prior but not in current;

  • "changed" — present in both, with at least one tracked field differing;

  • "unchanged" — present in both, with every tracked field equal.

Two values are treated as equal when both are NA, and as differing when one is NA and the other is not. No scores, scales, bands, or thresholds are invented or recomputed: this is a purely structural diff. RPN movement is read from each register's own stored rpn (the value create_risk_register() already computed), and risk_level is likewise read as stored; both are reported as movement rather than as tracked change fields, because they are derived from probability, impact, and detectability rather than edited directly.

See also

compare_risk_registers() for a lighter RPN/level diff, risk_reduction_summary() for the before/after reduction magnitude, risk_trend() for the trajectory across many milestones.

Examples

prior <- create_risk_register(data.frame(
  risk_id       = c("R001", "R002", "R003"),
  description   = c("Missing SDTM variables", "Unmapped ADaM derivations",
                    "Inconsistent define.xml"),
  probability   = c(4, 3, 2),
  impact        = c(5, 4, 3),
  detectability = c(2, 3, 4),
  status        = c("open", "open", "open")
))
current <- create_risk_register(data.frame(
  risk_id       = c("R001", "R002", "R004"),
  description   = c("Missing SDTM variables", "Unmapped ADaM derivations",
                    "Late-breaking lab data"),
  probability   = c(2, 3, 3),
  impact        = c(5, 4, 4),
  detectability = c(2, 3, 2),
  status        = c("mitigated", "open", "open")
))
rec <- reconcile_risk_registers(prior, current)
rec
#> ℹ Risk Reconciliation: 3 prior risk(s) -> 3 current
#> ℹ Added: 1, removed: 1, changed: 1, unchanged: 1
#> ℹ Total RPN: 100 -> 80 (-20 delta)
rec$per_risk
#> # A tibble: 4 × 9
#>   risk_id change_type n_fields_changed changed_fields      rpn_prior rpn_current
#>   <chr>   <chr>                  <int> <chr>                   <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1 R001    changed                    2 probability, status        40          20
#> 2 R004    added                      0 NA                         NA          24
#> 3 R003    removed                    0 NA                         24          NA
#> 4 R002    unchanged                  0 NA                         36          36
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: rpn_delta <dbl>, level_prior <chr>, level_current <chr>
rec$field_changes
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   risk_id field       value_prior value_current
#>   <chr>   <chr>       <chr>       <chr>        
#> 1 R001    probability 4           2            
#> 2 R001    status      open        mitigated
